## What This Site Is

House Unlimited Nigeria is a verified real estate agency and property developer operating in Abuja, Nigeria. The company specialises in:

- Off-plan luxury residential developments
- Verified land sales with Certificate of Occupancy (C of O)
- Estate plot sales in prime Abuja corridors
- Investment property advisory for diaspora and local buyers
- On-site property inspection and title verification services
